proof_strategy: Run exact TorsionSubgroup(E) and compare with the torsion invariants carried by the PseudoMordellWeilGroup map.
If RankBounds=[0,0], the exact torsion subgroup is the full E(K); enumerate it directly and filter rational quotient x-coordinates.

If RankBounds=[1,1], take the free PseudoMordellWeilGroup generator P. Equal rank implies the subgroup generated by torsion and P has finite index. Run Saturation([P],2:TorsionFree:=true); use the returned 2-saturated generator together with exact torsion. This proves the remaining index is odd.

For rank-one, construct an abstract Z/2+Z/2+Z map to E from the exact torsion generators and the 2-saturated free generator, then elliptic Chabauty with IndexBound=2. Since the subgroup has finite odd index and the Chabauty obstruction integer is 2-primary, completeness follows.
Reconstruct every rational parent x from quotient X=A(x-1/x), exact-test C(Q), receiver degeneracy, and all four parent square conditions.
